set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: W02.2
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Frontend/integration engineer with curator
Scope: Add minimal project work management tied to repository objects.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: W02 (bd-01M4W40KPVEFQSMWFEDZZC69SW)
Suggested delivery tranche: T4; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Support task assignment/status/notes with checked concurrency, attributable activity and exact dataset/release references when relevant.
2. Separate operational task completion from scientific acceptance and quality review; old verdicts remain bound to the reviewed release.
3. Apply current underlying permissions to task titles, notes, notifications/activity and attachments; cross-project references confer no access.
4. Test hidden dataset names and source references in task titles, notes, attachments and activity after a placement move/offboarding; work assignment is not an access grant.

Verification: Shared catalog/API state tests for stale edits, release changes, reassignment, withdrawal and hidden-note canaries.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/W02.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- docs/vision.md
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- F02.3: bd-01M4W5P591G5D5048MSJ46BN27
- F03.3: bd-01M4W5P5MCD12DVHWQC1KFXNDP

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: W02.2: Persist assigned curation tasks, notes and review state
